def compress_sentence(n, words):
    if n == 1:
        return words[0]
    
    compressed = words[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        word = words[i]
        max_overlap = 0
        for j in range(1, min(len(compressed), len(word)) + 1):
            if compressed[-j:] == word[:j]:
                max_overlap = j
        compressed += word[max_overlap:]
    return compressed
